alerts.empty: All clear. You have no pending alerts right now.
alerts.emergency_fund_no_data: No cash account data yet. Add «Bank» or «Cash» assets and enter their balances in Net worth to compare against your emergency fund goal.
alerts.emergency_fund_below_target: Your liquidity ({{liquid}}) is below your emergency fund goal ({{target}}, {{months}} months of expenses). You are short {{shortfall}}; you cover {{monthsCovered}} months.
alerts.emergency_fund_critical: Critical liquidity: only {{liquid}} in cash vs a {{target}} goal. Short by {{shortfall}} ({{monthsCovered}} months covered vs {{months}} target).
alerts.monthly_close_overdue: You have {{count}} months without a close (oldest: {{month}}). Record balances to update net worth and the dashboard.
alerts.monthly_close_due: {{days}} days left in {{month}}. Have you recorded your account and debt balances?

menu.title: Account and preferences
menu.guestHint: You can use the app without an account. Register to save your progress in the cloud.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Profile, session, and parameters used by the dashboard and projection.
account.saveCloudError: Saved on this device, but cloud sync failed. Try again.

profile.title: Personal profile
profile.hint: Name and age shown in the app and menu.

cloud.title: Cloud backup
cloud.hintCloud: When you save, your profile and financial parameters are updated in Supabase.
cloud.hintLocal: Data stays in this browser only.

financial.title: Financial parameters
financial.hint: Returns and inflation used in projections. Edit income and expenses under Balance.
financial.returnRealHint: Today's purchasing power (recommended for long-term planning).
financial.returnNominalHint: Before inflation; useful to compare products.
financial.savingsHint: Typical interest on deposits and savings accounts.
financial.salaryIncreaseHint: Only affects projections with salary growth enabled.
financial.realReturnBanner: You are using real returns: projection results are in today's purchasing power.

auth.registerSubtitle: Email and password. Your local data will be copied to your account.
auth.loginSubtitle: Use the email and password for your account.
auth.notConfigured: Cloud registration requires VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in the environment.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account. Your local data stays until you sign in.
auth.confirmEmailSubtitle: Your account is created. One more step to sign in.
auth.confirmEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to:
auth.confirmStep2: Open the link in your inbox
auth.confirmStep3: Come back here and sign in
auth.simpleModeNotice: Account stays in this browser only. Your password is stored encrypted locally; no emails or Google.
auth.success: Signed in. Your data is being saved to the cloud.
auth.migrationFailed: Signed in, but not all data could be uploaded. It will retry on next sign-in.

errors.generic: Could not complete. Check your email and password.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This email already has an account.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.emailSendRateLimit: Too many emails sent. Wait a while and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your net worth, cashflow and monthly trend.
dashboard.subtitleWithEstimates: Some fixed expenses are estimated until you complete them in Balance.

saveBanner.message: You have unsaved changes — register to keep your progress.

alerts.negative_cashflow: Your expenses exceed your income this month.
alerts.low_savings_rate: You are saving less than 10% of your income.
alerts.credit_card_debt: You have credit card debt. Consider paying it down first.
alerts.negative_net_worth: Your debt exceeds your assets. Review your liabilities.

netWorth.title: Net worth over time
netWorth.empty: Close months in Balance to see historical trends.

assets.title: Asset allocation
assets.empty: Record values in the monthly close to see the breakdown.

emergencyFund.title: Emergency fund
emergencyFund.noSnapshots: Enter balances in Net worth (Bank or Cash assets) to see this indicator
emergencyFund.have: You have {{amount}} · covers {{months}} months of expenses

balance.title: Net worth
balance.description: Your real numbers live here: income, expenses, annual growth and contributions. Dashboard and projection read them automatically.

cashflow.summaryHint: Summary of today's active period (income, expenses and savings).
cashflow.expensesSubtitle: Mortgage, household and leisure for the current period. Changes update the active period and projection.
cashflow.tramosSubtitle: Your situation today: salary and paychecks. If they change, add a period with the month it starts.
cashflow.tramosCurrentExpensesHint: Edit expense breakdown (mortgage, household, leisure…) in the section above; here you see the period summary.
cashflow.salaryHistorySubtitle: Each period is your paycheck from a given date. The one marked «Current» applies today; projection uses the latest matching period per month.
cashflow.expenseIncreaseHint: 0% = flat expenses; raise if you expect higher housing/leisure costs
cashflow.salaryNormalHint: Your usual paycheck amount, before spreading extra pays
cashflow.salaryFourteenNote: Extra June and December paychecks are spread across 12 months for a smooth projection. To model them as spikes, add them as a one-off annual income (coming soon).
cashflow.salaryOtherNote: With {{count}} paychecks, effective monthly income is (paycheck × {{count}}) / 12.
cashflow.annualExpensesSubtitle: Non-monthly costs you can estimate: property tax, car insurance, service, holidays, seasonal clothing…
cashflow.emergencyFundSubtitle: How many months of expenses do you want on hand? Many advisors suggest 3–6 months; 6 is a common benchmark.

contributions.title: Monthly contributions
contributions.subtitle: How much you set aside to invest each month (funds, ETF, pension…). Not your total net worth.
contributions.scopeNote: Only monthly amounts you invest. Wealth you already hold (accounts, funds, debt) lives under Assets & debts; the projection starting point is set under Projection.
contributions.totalMonthlyHint: Sum of active lines with an amount. The projection adds these on top of monthly savings.
contributions.totalMonthlyEmpty: Add at least one line with an amount to feed the projection.
contributions.weightedReturnHint: Weighted by each line's amount and return (real, after inflation).
contributions.plansSubtitle: Each line sets amount, growth and return used in the projection.
contributions.empty: No contributions yet. Add at least one line to feed the projection.
contributions.providerCustomPlaceholder: e.g. fund manager, broker or bank

patrimony.title: Assets & liabilities
patrimony.subtitle: Define your accounts and debts below (bank, fund, mortgage…). Enter amounts with the «Enter balances (€)» button.
patrimony.recordBalancesWhy: How much you have in each account and how much you owe. Without amounts there is no net worth or emergency fund progress.
patrimony.recordBalancesBlocked: Add an active asset or liability below first (bank, fund, mortgage…). Then you can enter balances in €.
patrimony.stepsNeedBalances: Step 2 · You have accounts listed. Tap «Enter balances (€)» to add how much each holds.
patrimony.noAccountsYet: Add an asset or liability below before you can enter balances
patrimony.recordBalancesSubtitle: Enter each asset balance and outstanding debt for {{month}} ({{date}}). Updates net worth, dashboard and emergency fund.
patrimony.recordBalancesUpdateSubtitle: Correct amounts for {{month}} if they changed since last time.
patrimony.recordBalancesMonth: Which month are these balances for?
patrimony.recordBalancesMonthPending: Some lines in this month are still missing amounts.
patrimony.recordBalancesMonthClosed: This month already has saved balances (you can update them).
patrimony.closeUpdateSubtitle: Update amounts if they changed. Replaces that month's close.
patrimony.closePromptOverdue: Balance amounts (€) are missing for {{count}} months (since {{month}}). Enter them so net worth and the dashboard stay accurate.
patrimony.closePromptDue: {{days}} days left in {{month}}. Are your account and debt balances still up to date?
patrimony.closePromptCurrent: You have not entered balance amounts for {{month}} yet. Do it now or pick another month.
patrimony.closeSubtitle: Enter each asset balance and outstanding debt. Saved with month-end date.
patrimony.closeEmpty: Add at least one active asset or liability before closing the month.
patrimony.closeLiabilitiesHint: Outstanding balance (stored as debt in net worth).
patrimony.assetsSubtitle: Accounts, funds, cash, property… Multiple lines per bank or broker.
patrimony.saveHint: Fill in the details and tap Save; adding a line does not save by itself.
patrimony.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
patrimony.liabilitiesSubtitle: Mortgage, loans, cards… Balance updated on monthly close.
patrimony.name: Name
patrimony.providerHint: Pick your institution; if it is not listed, choose «Other».
patrimony.monthlyPaymentHint: For future sync with fixed expenses
patrimony.historyEmpty: Close at least one month to see the history table.

projection.title: Future projection
projection.subtitle: Month-by-month projection with compound interest. Wealth grows from net contributions plus return on what was already invested (this month's contribution does not earn return until next month).

sources.title: Projection data sources
sources.hint: Income & expenses → Cashflow. Monthly contributions → Contributions tab. Starting net worth & return → Parameters below.
sources.noContributions: Add contributions under Net worth → Contributions (funds, ETF or pension) to fill Additional investments in the table.

settings.title: Projection parameters
settings.hint: Horizon, projection starting net worth and global return. Income, expenses and monthly contributions are edited under Net worth.
settings.initialPatrimonyHint: Where the simulation starts before adding monthly contributions and interest. Can match your real net worth, but is not auto-filled—enter it or use the button if you updated balances under Assets & debts.
settings.noPatrimonyClose: No balances for this month in Assets & debts.
settings.returnModeTooltip: Real = gain after inflation (purchasing power). Nominal = gross market figure.

summary.returnGeneratedHint: What compound interest generated above your contributions.
summary.configuredReturnHint: Value set above; not a calculated average.
summary.breakdownTitle: What makes up your final net worth
summary.breakdownFinal: Net worth at end of period

table.scrollHint: Swipe sideways to see all columns

welcome.title: Welcome to FinanciaApp
welcome.subtitle: In a few minutes you will have a clear view of your cashflow and saving capacity. Everything is stored on this device.
welcome.name: Name
welcome.ageHint: For projections and retirement; does not affect monthly cashflow.
welcome.ageErrorTooYoung: You must be at least {{min}} years old to use the app.
welcome.ageErrorInvalid: Enter a valid whole number for your age.
welcome.formIncomplete: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.

income.title: Your income
income.intro: Enter net amounts (what lands in your account after tax and withholdings).
income.grossNetBody: Use your net pay: what hits your bank each month. Gross is on your contract and is usually higher — do not use it here.

expenses.title: Your monthly expenses
expenses.subtitle: Four blocks: housing, household, groceries and leisure. Use averages if they vary each month.
expenses.householdHint: Monthly average: power, water, gas, insurance, internet and similar (not grocery shopping).
expenses.groceriesHint: Monthly average for supermarket, pantry and meals you cook at home.
expenses.leisureHint: Monthly average: restaurants, going out, hobbies, non-essential shopping…
expenses.useDetailedView: I prefer to break down utilities, insurance, etc.
expenses.detailedIntro: Optional: enter each line yourself (utilities, insurance…). We never auto-fill amounts.
expenses.mortgageRentTotalHint: Full instalment amount, even if you split it with others.
expenses.sharePreview: We will count {{yours}}/month in your expenses (of {{total}} total).

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: Review what you entered. There is nothing else to fill in here.
summary.hint: Net worth, accounts and investments will be set up in Balance. You can change income and expenses anytime.
summary.registerPrompt: Save this progress to the cloud?
